g.text: W5 version target renamed or released early
add task "slug" in the repo project, label ?stub or ?seed
write draft (version, slug, date, status = draft, empty body)
find content = slug in the mapped project (open, then completed)
todo add "slug" --project <mapped> --label (%deliverable if output non-empty else %actionable)
find version target "<repo>@v0.4.0" in the parent project
ensure milestone "v0.4.0" (state from checked, due from due)
create issue, title = slug, body = dev <slug> --md (checklist from rows, notes verbatim), milestone = v0.4.0
set task description = markdown link to the issue
rewrite the first line of the version target's description: -> <repo>#N ...
find subtask by content under id, todo done id:<sub>
error row, content drifted, nothing written
error row, task gone, set aborted or clear the reference
error row, target has no version task, nothing written
check "nu-fluency@v0.4.0" while member tickets are open
close milestone v0.4.0, open issues stay assigned
result row names the failed leg and next command
ensure steps find nothing to do
dev ignores it: no file exists yet
seed: dev migrate <slug>, or dev new <slug> --prompt --files <issue.md>
status = draft: the github leg is skipped
target set but no <repo>@<version> task in Todoist: error row, add it there first
git switch -c <slug>: the track hook resolves the branch to the task
proposal: closure is accepted from any surface, reopening only from Todoist
mirrors Todoist: a closed milestone with open issues is allowed on both sides
